items.title: API Gateway pattern
items.detail: Single entry point that routes, authenticates and rate-limits client requests for a set of backend services.

items.title: Backend for Frontend (BFF)
items.detail: A dedicated gateway variant tailored to a specific client type.

items.title: Reverse proxy
items.detail: A server that forwards client requests to upstream servers and returns their responses.

items.title: Service discovery & health checking
items.detail: How a load balancer learns which upstream instances are healthy.

items.title: Configuration externalization
items.detail: Keeping routing/feature configuration outside the running instances so it can change live.

items.title: JSON Web Tokens (JWT)
items.detail: Signed tokens whose signatures are verified with public keys from a key store.

items.title: Token bucket rate limiting
items.detail: A bucket of tokens refilled at a fixed rate; requests spend tokens.

items.title: Graceful configuration reload
items.detail: Applying new routing rules without dropping in-flight requests or restarting.

items.title: Horizontal scaling
items.detail: Adding stateless instances behind a load balancer to increase capacity.

items.title: NGINX / Envoy / HAProxy
items.detail: Production-grade reverse proxies and service proxies with L7 routing.

items.title: Kong / Traefik / AWS API Gateway
items.detail: Managed or self-hosted API gateway products.

items.title: HashiCorp Vault / AWS Secrets Manager
items.detail: Secret stores for signing keys and certificates.

items.title: Redis / etcd / Consul
items.detail: Low-latency stores commonly used for live configuration.
